nodes.text: Suddenly Jeremy bursts into the barn!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Hey, Delilah, have you--
Jeremy stops talking when he sees Erik. His eyes narrow.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey!
Erik bounds out of the tractor and offers a hand to Jeremy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm Erik!
Jeremy gives Erik's hand a hard squeeze.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Jeremy. I'm a senior at Jefferson High.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ow! What a grip!

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: I'm also the Harvest Festival coordinator. That means next week, when the Festival is going full tilt...

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Everything you see, from the carnival games to the pumpkins to the floats in the processional, all of it will be because of me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow, that sounds important! All I manage is an inn in the fantasy realm of Ogres 'N' Elves. It's called `The Innie` after my belly button...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, that sounds important! All I manage is an inn in the fantasy realm of Ogres 'N' Elves. It's called [color=#e23b3b][i]The Innie[/i][/color] after my belly button...

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Here's a tip. If you want to be cool like me, stop playing those lame fantasy games.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But they're fun...

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Says no one ever. Anyway, how are you, Delilah? How's your father?

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: His business is important to me, but your happiness is more important.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Thanks...
Jeremy flashes Erik a smile.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: ..,But you don't have to keep saying that.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: In fact, I think I'll go now. Daddy should be able to fix the tractor.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Having problems? I can fix it.
In a flash, Jeremy is inspecting the tractor's engine.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: You've got your position lift too low, so you're going to dig too far into the ground.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I'm impressed!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Which is not good...

The present...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, the tractor?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was just revisiting the memory... I didn't think the tractor worked, but I guess Jeremy fixed it. He's so capable!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He's also a slimeball.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Big time.
The Troublemakers turn to Paige and Owen, surprised.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Er, I can't believe I, uh, agree with you, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, whoa! Hey, that `was` weird!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, whoa! Hey, that [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] weird!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, because you're always very annoying, and, uh, I'm always very annoyed with you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, um, if you stopped being so selfish and spoiled all the time, I'd be nicer to you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! Can you imagine Owen and Paige being `nice` to each other! So funny!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Can you imagine Owen and Paige being [color=#e23b3b][i]nice[/i][/color] to each other! So funny!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Anyway... Please stop fighting so everyone can focus on me and Delilah, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All I know is I like this girl! She seems so perfect for you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you're into her, it makes sense why you've been acting so weird. Er, weirder than normal.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's hopeless, though! Jeremy's right. I've got no chance with her!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm a snowball in a real hot place!
Off in the distance, Jeremy is talking to Delilah. He pats her on the arm.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Welp! That's it! I'm toast and strawberry jam!
Erik starts walking away, but Spencer catches him by the collar.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hold on, Weirdo.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, you can't give up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Have you seen this guy's resume?! Engine skills?! Harvest Festival helpfulness?! Arm-patting?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I lost, guys. I didn't score the endzone! I hit an out and went out of bounds on the foul ball!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know sports, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Erik, it sounded like you and Delilah might have had a chance before Jeremy showed up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It did?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, you guys had some major chemistry!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know... Now that Jeremy's pursuing her, I'll get all nervous and goofy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude. You're already both those things.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's there to be worried about?! We'll help you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You will?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We will?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sure... And I already have a plan in mind!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heh... So, if you don't mind talking some more...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: No, talking's fun! My daddy doesn't really talk much ever, so it's kind of the greatest thing when it happens.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pumpkins! You should totally talk to me about pumpkins!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I love pumpkins!
Delilah puts her hand on Erik's arm.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Get this! The largest pumpkin pie ever made was five feet in diameter!
Erik find himself leaning closer toward Delilah, almost unconsciously...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No way... I'd get so sick eating that!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It weighed over 350 pounds!
Closer...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's, like, three of me!
Erik suddenly realizes just how close the two of them are...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Roasted marshmallows! This is it! My first kiss!
Erik closes his eyes, and--
Erik reaches over and holds Delilah's hand. She pulls it away awkwardly.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm just... Not comfortable yet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, uh... I should have asked.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: No, that's not something you should really ask. Asking kind of kills the romance of it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So... Then I'll just proceed through the rest of my romantic life blind as ever...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee! That's kind of what most guys are doing anyway.
Erik smiles at Delilah, and for one second, it feels like there's something more between them, a spark...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've never sat in a tractor before!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: It's great! You feel like you're the queen of the farm! Or king, in your case...
A silence fills the tractor. Erik can feel himself start to panic!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't let it be awkward! Do something! Do something!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, squash me in a blanket! What a coinkydink!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! Such a small world!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, let me ask you about pumpkins...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh no! We `have` to talk about Benjamin now! Tell me your favorite Ben Franklin fact!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! We [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to talk about Benjamin now! Tell me your favorite Ben Franklin fact!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My favorite? Well, it's so hard to choose... But if I had to... I'd say... I've always... Admired...
Erik racks his brain for one Benjamin Franklin fact...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...His Presidency!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Benjamin was `never` President!
nodes.text_bbcode: Benjamin was [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] President!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He wasn't? But he's on the $100 bill...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Never President. A fan would know that... But you're not really a fan, are you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... To be honest, I thought you were talking about Paul Revere.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, he's cool too... You know, I wish you'd just said that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too...
Erik notices the empty seat next to Delilah, and he slinks up into it. She scoots away from him.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I like him too!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For a second, I thought we were fans of the same historical figure!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: That would have been `too` weird, I think.
nodes.text_bbcode: That would have been [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] weird, I think.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, give me your best Ben Franklin fact!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Okay! Did you know that Ben Franklin basically invented the public library?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No way! Every time I check out a book, I'll think of you... I mean, I'll think of him!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee! Your turn! What's your best Revere factoid?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Bet you didn't know that Paul Revere had sixteen children!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: What?! That's insane!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think if I had that many kids, I'd give them numbers instead of names.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee!
There's a pause, then...

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Who do you think would win in a fight? Your guy or mine?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No offense, but mine.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Yeah, Paul Revere seemed bigger and more athletic.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, for what it's worth, I think Ben Franklin would win in a game of chess.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Revere would probably overvalue his horses.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Want to come sit up here with me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: I've always considered myself to be a bit of a nerd.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Really? You don't look like it! Er, I don't mean that as an insult... Not that nerds are known for being attractive!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just that nerds aren't usually so pretty... I mean... Uh... Is it getting hot in this barn?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Heh. So, what are you into?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Well, this is embarrassing, but I'm a big fan of a certain historical figure, one of the most important in American history!
Erik's heart, already pounding in his chest, thumps loudly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I... Me... Too.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You don't mean...?

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You're a Benjamin Franklin fan too?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ben Franklin?! I mean, uh...

options.label: Actually, I sort of revere Paul Revere!

nodes.text: Are you here to study my daddy's pumpkins?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am! I'm kind of a nerd about plants. Really, I'm a nerd about everything, but `especially` our green oxygen producers!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am! I'm kind of a nerd about plants. Really, I'm a nerd about everything, but [color=#e23b3b][i]especially[/i][/color] our green oxygen producers!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You wouldn't be much of a horticulturist otherwise, would you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huh-ho! Not many people know that word!

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: If I didn't, I wouldn't be much of a pumpkin farmer's daughter, would I?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: You know, you're kinda cute.

nodes.speaker: Delilah
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I mean... I `know` about girls... How they function.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean... I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] about girls... How they function.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've studied them!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Er... Can I bury myself in a hole somewhere? Right next to all the other nerds who've blown it this bad?
Delilah laughs politely.

nodes.speaker: Jeremy
nodes.text: Delilah's not interested in you! So stay away! Or else!

nodes.text: Well, that was fun! Where was I? Oh yeah, my story!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who `was` that guy?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi

args.text: Suddenly a hand reaches out and shoves the stack of hay bales, knocking it over!
That was a weird thing to say. Also, uh, hey, Delilah.
$ALLISON, Spencer, and Paige are now facing Delilah. Owen and Kimi arrive, out-of-breath.
Sorry, we couldn't get here in time. This guy's faster than he looks!
What's going on?! What is this, Erik?!
I'll fill in the blanks for you. These two lured me away so that these three could whisper to this nerd because he can't get you on his own. Pathetic!
I'm afraid so, Delilah. I'm a sham. A charlatan. A flim-flammer.
Those aren't terms anyone uses, Erik.
I get the gist, and I'm appalled.
Erik, how could you be so dishonest? I liked you plenty in the barn...
...Oh, but that was fake, too, wasn't it?
If I said it wasn't, would you believe me?
That was all Erik in the barn. We don't know what he said to you. We weren't there.
This from the girl who was just betraying your trust from behind a wall of hay?
I was not betraying trust! I was helping a friend!
I know that's how it feels, but Erik needed us.
Didn't you hear me? He did fine by himself earlier!
Thanks, $ALLISON. I can handle this now. Adrenaline is my servant.
Yeah, maybe we had something in the barn, but that was before this Jeremy guy swooped in like some kind of hawk-mechanic!
Delilah, I knew that if I tried to talk to you, I'd just get tongue-tied and blow it... The same way I always do!
So I had my friends help me! Is that so wrong?
It is when you say something that isn't coming from you!
Actually, a lot of what Erik said didn't come from us.
Yeah, I do a lot of improv.
So, it was just you in the barn? You swear?
Awww... You promise not to do anything like this ever again?
Then I forgive you... After all, it sounds like you were just trying extra hard to impress me.
I was! I mean, I've never really liked anyone the way I like you...
Before he can say anything more, Delilah leans forward and gives him a soft kiss on the cheek.
A hand reaches out and clamps down on Erik's shoulder, spinning him around!
Delilah's father is there, glaring at Erik.
Mr. Horner, I swear I didn't do anything unsavory or savory or anything at all with your daughter!
Okay, okay! We sat in a tractor together, but that's it! I promise!
Mr. Horner looks to his daughter.
Yup. What do ya think of this one, darling?
Delilah stands next to Erik and holds his hand.
Mr. Horner nods, extending his dirt-covered hand out to Erik. Erik shakes it.
Psst. Now would be a good time to say something!
The moment hangs there for a while and then Mr. Horner cracks a smile.
Later, on the way back to Twin Branches...
Wait, Erik... Didn't you say that Jeremy was the reason you ended up in Troublemakers?
Yeah, I want to hear `that` story!
I can't even imagine you doing anything wrong.
Well, I didn't really do anything wrong, per se.
After I saw all the volunteer work Jeremy was doing, I realized that I could probably do a little more for the community!
This thing we do as a punishment... You do for fun?
It's not really all that bad! You get to help people, and you get to make friends!
Plus, I got kissed by a girl!

{ Ho de-dee dee-dum! Just stacking up some hay bales... All by myself... No one else here! Dum dee dum dee dum! {
On the other side of the stack next to him, $ALLISON is pressed against a small gap in the hay.
Why am I the one doing this again?
Paige and Spencer are hovering over both her shoulders.
I guess it's because you're quiet!
I think I just proved my point!
I get that. It's just... Well, I'm supposed to be assisting Erik in his relationship entanglement...
What are you talking about, Red?!
You made friends with all of us in, like, two seconds!
But I don't know the first thing about love...
No one does! I've been single for forever, and Paige and Owen hate each other now more than ever!
I mean, er, yeah! Owen's the worst! I hate him and his... Cheap haircuts.
See? You know just as much as we do!
Plus, you've got that whole cute freshman thing going. You'll find a guy, trust me.
Did Spencer just call me cute?!
Uh, I guess you're right... Thanks!
{ Ho do dop bo bop! Singing while I work... Totally alone... Really want some raisins! Doo dop boo wop bop! {
Tell him to stop singing! He's ruining his chances already!
No, it's cute! Tell him to sing more!
$ALLISON leans closer against the bale and tells Erik to...
{ Dum dum dee dum! Making music with my mouth... Trying not to sneeze... So many allergies! Doopity doop-boop! {
Ha! Told you it was cute!
I didn't know she was tone-deaf!
Hi! Er, or I guess more appropriately, `hay!`
I knew it! No one wants to hear that awful--
It seemed like good advice... Er, like a good idea!
Oh... I liked hearing your voice.
Someone was just bragging about something?
Maybe `next time` you'll actually listen to me!
Uh, anyway, hi! Er, or I guess more appropriately, `hay!`
Delilah snorts, laughing. She comes over...
He should start with a compliment! Something about her shoes!
Spencer leans in a little closer as he whispers, and $ALLISON finds herself blushing from just how close he is.
I `love` shoes, but he should say something about her hair!
Erik looks down at her dirt-covered sandals.
Good call, $ALLISON. Compliment a `farmer's daughter` on her manure-covered moccasins.
Did you say something just now?
Uh, nope! Must have been my stomach! Sometimes it's louder than it should be!
So you and Jeremy... You're not... Uh...
No! I mean, not that there's anything wrong with Jeremy. He's a great guy!
But he's kind of... Not a great guy. I like guys with good, warm hearts.
That's so funny because `my` heart is very warm right now... It's like fresh-baked bread!
Wow. The dork readings in this area are off the chart.
This is it! He should ask her out!
So what you just said is...
I don't understand what you're trying to say...
Was that confusing? I'm nervous! What I really wanted to say was--
It sounds like you're trying to ask me out!
Yeah, yeah. Looks like your plan actually paid off.
I am! I'm just a little nervous!
That's really sweet! Of course I'll go--
I really like how smart you are!
No, it's just... Well, it feels like the kind of thing a guy says to make it seem like he's interested without being offensive.
And you'd prefer it if I offended you?
No! I'd prefer it if you just said what you actually felt!
Maybe you should leave the advice giving to me.
`I'd` want to be complimented on my intelligence.
Yeah, 'cause you're just like every girl.
Well, then... I really like your laugh! You snort just like a pig!
I, uh, I really like your hair...
Yeah, it makes you look like a panther!
Consider yourself flattered! Panther fur is very shiny!

nodes.text: I'm certain this chapter is where Birk and Contessa find true love, provided no one discovers their secret passion!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You planning on working?

nodes.text: Right now, I'm supervising you not working!

nodes.text: Uh oh. Here comes the big fight! I can't take it!

nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't--

nodes.text: Wait... Where's Erik?
